model.title: Northern Nevada Economic Development and Conservation Act of 2026
model.meta: Agriculture Committee, Natural Resources Committee · Rep. Mark Amodei (R-NV)

summary.text: The bill would transfer some federally owned lands in northern Nevada to state or local control and allow the disposal of other federal lands in the region to support economic development projects. It also aims to promote conservation efforts in northern Nevada.
